outline.text: How I improve your event ROI
I promote your event to my audience and drive qualified people to register.
Every registrant gets a personalized welcome call. I learn why they're coming and who they want to meet, then follow up so they actually show up.
You get insights and more context on who's coming to your event and why.
Curated matches and double opt-in introductions, so guests arrive with intros already lined up.
Sponsors get real meetings with the guests they came to meet, which makes your sponsor package worth more.
Free for every approved event. Partner adds promotion and sponsor meetings.
Reach Boardy's audience of 400K+ and attract qualified registrants.
Personalized welcome calls and follow-ups, tailored to your event, help guests show up.
Understand why guests are coming and who they want to meet.
Guests get curated matches and introductions once both people opt in.
Post-event sponsor meetings make your sponsorship packages more valuable.
